basis: PROVISIONAL (T5, 2026-10-11). NOT APPROVED. DR-0015 conditional approval: no numerical tolerance is final until the T7 three-platform measurement and threshold DR. Values are the DR-0015 candidates where one exists; otherwise the DR-0015 method applied to the T5 reference-host measurements (VAL-0013): about 2x measured for truncation-type errors, magnitude-relative 1e-12 for round-off-type quantities (the O1/O2 candidate class), approved convergence-order policy |p - 4| <= 0.5 (DR-0008). Exact contract checks (event order, traceability, outcomes, control, determinism, DR-0018 boundary) are not tolerances and are not in this file. O9 (GMAT) is T6 and FU-1 (GMAT gate recalibration, 11-15 um DOP853 cross-platform floor) is T7; neither is here. The DR-0017 timing-induced delta-v budget (1e-7 m/s per burn) is enforced by the simulator at acceptance and is not a trajectory-error bound.

limit_basis.o1_mass_law: DR-0015 candidate 1e-12 (round-off class, relative to initial mass). depletion_residual_over_bound_max: analytic DR-0017 D1a bound mdot * 2 ulp(cutoff); exact, not a tolerance.
limit_basis.o2_rocket_equation: DR-0015 candidate 1e-12 (round-off class, relative to delta-v), applied to the error in excess of the analytic RK4 (Simpson) truncation bound h^5/2880 * 24 F mdot^4 / m^5 summed over the burn's sub-steps. For the reference vehicle the bound is 5e-13 m/s (1.8e-14 relative), so the gate is effectively unchanged. The O6 high-thrust variants (up to 16x thrust, mdot^4 = 65 536x) carry a genuine truncation error up to 2.0e-11 relative, which the analytic bound predicts to 2-3 % (VAL-0013). The raw relative error is reported (sensed_delta_v_rel_error_max). Not a weakening: the round-off allowance is unchanged and the truncation term is computed, not tuned.
limit_basis.o3_free_space: Velocity and propellant: round-off class 1e-12 (VAL-0011, T1 test bound). Position: genuine 4th-order truncation, checked by order |p - 4| <= 0.5 (DR-0008 policy), not by an absolute value. timing_violations: the reported ignition and cutoff must equal the requested interval exactly (review M2-T5 F5).
limit_basis.o4_reference: Initial state vs the independently derived circular-orbit state: round-off class 1e-12 relative (review M2-T5 F1). Ignition states (BurnStarted) share the cutoff limits; ignition precedes cutoff, so its error is smaller (review F11). Thrust direction at every burning PropulsionSampled vs the reference velocity direction (|a/|a| - u_ref|): the O4 cutoff velocity limit divided by orbital speed (3e-6 / 7.7e3 = 4e-10; m2_invalid_commands 2e-5 / 7.7e3 = 2.6e-9), since the reference and simulated velocity directions differ by about |dv|/|v| (measured 1.3e-10..1.5e-10; 1.2e-9). Not a new independent tolerance (review F10). Every StateSampled (coast and powered, all runs including O6/O8 auxiliary runs): same limits as the final state; measured maxima 0.2906 m (prograde, at 53 400 s), 0.3127, 0.2891, 0.2973, 0.298 m (review F3/F6/F7). DR-0015 candidates: cutoff <= 2e-3 m / 3e-6 m/s (slice, retrograde, depletion: cutoff before 730 s), final <= 0.6 m / 7e-4 m/s at 53 700 s. m2_invalid_commands: last cutoff at 2420 s, after a longer coast; ~2x measured (8.0e-3 m, 1.0e-5 m/s). The cutoff error is dominated by the pre-burn coast, not the burn.
limit_basis.o5_coast_kepler: ~2x measured (max 0.314 m, retrograde); equals the approved M1 Kepler limits for the same horizon and dt.
limit_basis.o6_impulsive_limit: DR-0015 candidates: |p - 2| <= 0.05 over every halving pair (5 levels); slice ratio <= 1e-5.
limit_basis.o7_direction: Signs exact. Plane rotation and inclination change: round-off class 1e-12 rad (measured <= 1.5e-16).
limit_basis.o8_convergence: DR-0008 policy |p - 4| <= 0.5 on dt 10 -> 5 -> 2.5 s (DR-0015 candidate). 20 -> 10 is pre-asymptotic; dt = 1 s approaches the DOP853 cross-platform floor.
limit_basis.accounting: Round-off class 1e-12 (relative to initial mass, or to the mission's total predicted delta-v). Includes per-sample propellant and sensed delta-v predicted from accepted commands and elapsed burn time, transition propellant, planned consumption and the thrust unit vector (reviews F9, F11, F12). Exact relations (mass = dry + propellant, idle intervals bit-identical, schedule, plan cutoffs, D1a cutoff, timing bound) are contract checks, not tolerances.
limit_basis.orbit_events: Node-crossing time vs independently located reference crossings (DOP853 + Kepler bisection): 8e-5 s, ~2x measured (<= 4.0e-5 s) and equal to the approved M1 node-crossing limit for the same dt and horizon. Altitude extrema vs reference apsides: the O4 sample-position limit 0.6 m (review F14).
